task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Use the right arm for the can with flat silver bottom, place the can with flat silver bottom in the basket with loop handle, and lift the basket with loop handle.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架使用银平底罐的右臂，将银平底罐放入环提篮中，提起环提篮。
